name: 5 Moves
notes: Unleash your inner grandmaster at Starr Craft Brewery's lively Chess Club! Here, the love for craft beer and chess blend seamlessly to create an entertaining experience. Whether you're an aspiring Bobby Fischer or a casual player who can't tell a pawn from a rook, this is the place for you. Our monthly meetups offer an opportunity to engage in friendly chess games while savoring our delicious, handcrafted brews. Our Chess Club meetings promise a blend of competition and camaraderie. We encourage players of all skill levels and ages to join us – it's the perfect chance to enhance your strategy skills or just learn the ropes. Checkmate? More like check-mate-y, as you might just find your next best friend across the board at our delightful chess gatherings!

name: Van TX Chess Club
notes: We start at 6pm on Friday, meeting at: Wendy's 133 County Road 314 Unit 100 Van TX Boards (and possibly clocks) are on loan from Lindale Chess Club and possibly Mineola Chess Club - The Tuesday Knights until we get our own equipment. The club is run by President James Wolfe but was launched Nikolaj Kaluderovic and his Van High School Chess Club but is open to all students and members of the community at large. Read the event post for more details. Come out to have some good games and snack or eat if desired. Typical club play is casual; typically you are committed to making a move once you let go. We want friendly games however so you if you and your opponent agree BEFORE a game starts you can choose to play "touch move", to agree to some takebacks, to play a timed game with a clock, etc. Chess variations such as "duck chess", "atomic chess", "bug house", etc. are all allowed -- it's a public venue and all legal behavior is permissible! -- but may not be encouraged. We strive to improve everyone's regular chess skills, which are often complicated enough! Our Facebook page: facebook.com/groups/vantxchessclub/

name: Chess on Tap
notes: Welcome to the official Chess.com club for Chess on Tap ! Join our online events, or find players from our OTB events, to continue your rivalry online! Chess on Tap is Washington, DC's premiere social chess club. If you're looking for a casual game of OTB chess in a fun atmosphere, join our Meetup group for event dates and times. Members at our events range from beginner to expert level, and games are played both with and without time controls. Whether you're an experienced speed chess player or you're just learning to play, you'll be able to find a good match and advice on how to improve your game.

name: Wichita Chess Club
notes: This club is a place for Wichita area players to meet up for games when we are not playing over the board. It is also an international community with a shared passion for chess. All are welcome! We have a very competitive vote chess team. We also do daily matches, post puzzles and games in the forum, and may have a live arena on occasion. Please feel free to join in! For those who are local, we also have a messenger group if anyone would like to join and stay current on Wichita chess events.

name: Eagle Landing Chess Club
notes: The Eagle Landing Chess Club is a casual, community-based chess club that provides a welcoming space for chess enthusiasts of all skill levels. Our club aims to foster a sense of camaraderie and community among chess players by offering chess open play, tournaments, events, and chess lessons. Whether you are a beginner looking to learn the game or an experienced player seeking challenging opponents, the Eagle Landing Chess Club is the perfect place to gather, play chess, and connect with fellow chess enthusiasts. Join us and be a part of our friendly and inclusive chess community!

name: Lufkin and Nacogdoches Chess Club
notes: Lufkin & Nacogdoches Chess Club Welcome to the Lufkin & Nacogdoches Chess Club! We are a vibrant community of chess enthusiasts meeting weekly on Wednesdays in Lufkin and monthly in Nacogdoches for over-the-board (OTB) chess. Our games typically range from 10 to 15 minutes, offering an engaging and fast-paced experience for players of all ages and skill levels. Join this club page to view our schedule! We host a tournament every quarter and organize special tournaments to support Solutions Arkitect , a nonprofit organization dedicated to empowering education through technology designed with students in mind. Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, you'll find a welcoming environment where you can improve your skills and enjoy the game. Join us and be part of the fun!

name: AACO of Arizona Chess Club
notes: Welcome to the AACO Chess Club! Chess is a great game that trains players to improve their strategic thinking, patience, time management, how to read your enemy, and more. All of these are great skills that can strengthen us as Assyrians. About the Club. Accepting all levels Regularly meet in person Will provide introductory training on concepts and openings Conduct tournaments Learn new tactics, practice your game, and increase your elo Build a social and fun community of Assyrians who love to play chess! For questions reach out to our leader: Mike Youkhana ( tigermikey39 ) — The Assyrian American Cultural Organization (AACO) of Arizona is an organization whose goal is to serve the needs of the local Assyrian community and to spark an interest and love for our Assyrian culture and heritage. https://assyrianamerican.org/ To be eligible to participate in an in-person tournament you must be a registered AACO member in good standing. To sign up visit this link: https://www.assyrianamerican.org/membership
